generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should have civil contractor registration in KPWD/KUWSDB etc.

Assessed Available Tender capacity (AxNx5.0-B) should be greater than the ampount put to tender A equals to Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N equals to Number of years B equals to Value of On-going works
The caste certificate and the Domocile certificate is mandatory to be uploaded in kppp-procurement portal
Form of Tender is mandatory to Upload in KPPP portal
Third Party will be nominated by BWSSB
The rates considered in the tender are based on CSR & is exclusive of GST

Refer Annexure(A) enclosed along for jurisdictions of the courts and safety measures to be taken while executing the works as per letter No.BWSSB/EIC/CE(P)/0027/16-17 Dt.10.04.2017 & further here by informed to include the same in the contract agreement
Note: Road cutting machine should be used mandatorily for cutting the approved width of road while executing the work as per circular No.BWSSB/CH/CAO-s/CHI/138/19-20 Dt.04.09.2019
All conditions are as per IFT and Bid Document

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Profit & loss Account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by Chartered accountant

Work Done certificate-The tenderer should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for atleast any construction work to an extent of 25 percentage of the cost of the work i.e.,Rs.10.23 lakhs

Providing lowering laying, jointing, testing and commissioning of following diameters glazed stone ware pipes, conforming to IS 651:1992, (with 5th revision) in all respects jointing with EPDM rubber rings (seals according to EN 681 & ASPM 425) The rubber seals joints pipe will have groves in interior of socket and exterior of the spigot.
